items.label: 【PREMIUM STAINLESS STEEL】
items.value: Made from Food-Grade stainless steel, this product ensures durability, rust resistance, and long-lasting performance, meeting all your dining needs.

items.label: 【GREAT VALUE FOR MONEY】
items.value: Each set includes 24 pieces, with 4 steak knives, making it perfect for a family of four or entertaining guests. Combining versatility with excellent value, this set is ideal for both everyday use and special occasions.

items.label: 【ELEGANT DESIGN & ERGONOMIC HANDLE】
items.value: Features an attractive mirror-polished finish for a sleek, professional look. The ergonomic design ensures a comfortable grip, and the edges are smoothly crafted, creating a pleasant dining experience.

items: 【USE AND MAINTENANCE】：Clean your set with warm water and a mild soap. After washing, make sure to thoroughly dry the pieces to keep their polished, mirror-like finish intact.Avoid using abrasive tools like steel wool, hard sponges, or scrubbing pads, as they could scratch or damage the surface when used.（！！！To remove fingerprints from stainless steel cutlery, use a soft microfiber cloth with warm, soapy water, then dry thoroughly to prevent water spots. ）

【PERFECT GIFT AND 99-YEAR WARRANTY】：Make someone's day with this exceptional silverware set – the perfect gift for any occasion, from housewarmings to holidays. Backed by a 99-year warranty, you can enjoy peace of mind knowing this set is built to last.
